description: SU(3) BMN index, eigenvalue (diagonal) graviton index and difference through j=36, SU(3)_R rep content
conventions: BMN sector of SU(N); sector = (2J, q1, q2, q3) with q_I = R_I + J, j = 2 sum q; Chang-Lin / Choi et al. conventions (summary/fortuity-summary.pdf, section 2)
checked: core content after dividing by prod_I(1-t^2 x_I) and prod_I(1-t^8 x_I)^{-1} matches Table 1 of arXiv:2312.16443 through j=36
caveat: the diagonal graviton count undercounts true multi-graviton classes (see R-002); the -1 at j=24 is such an artifact
